summary.headline: Front VIX rebounded while October carry supply remained active and deferred protection accumulated in December.
key_points: October and November forwards rose by roughly 0.3 VIX points from the prior late snapshot, while December remained near 18.7.
Prior OI strongly confirmed the December 17 synthetic-long book and the October 17.5 synthetic-short center.
Session signed VIX delta was about +37.7M, but excluding December 14C leaves about -2.0M.
October remained net short VIX while protection continued to roll outward into November and December.
summary.daily_note: Trade date is 2026-09-23. The snapshot was exported on 2026-09-24 at 08:53 Cyprus time.

leave_one_out.comment: The positive session delta is dominated by December 14C. Excluding that strike leaves the session approximately delta-neutral to slightly short VIX.
